# اِخْتَرَطْتِ (iḵtaraṭti) /ix.ta.ratˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اِخْتَرَطَتْ (iḵtaraṭat) /ix.ta.ra.tˤat/: third-p
